templates.title: Fresh batch
templates.summary: From the oven to the case to your hands: the tray coming out, the pick, the tear and what you take home.

steps.title: Out of the oven
steps.position: Behind the counter, with the baker's okay
steps.direction: Ask the baker first. Phone at chest height facing the oven, move in slowly as the tray comes out and the steam rises.

captions.script: Fresh from the oven, right now. Best time to be here.
A hot batch just came out. Listen to the crust crackle.

steps.title: The case
steps.position: In front of the display case
steps.direction: Phone at shelf height, slide sideways along the case at an even pace so the labels and prices pass by.

captions.script: Everything in the case today. Take a slow look with me.
Take your pick. Here are the prices as we pass the labels.

steps.title: Your pick
steps.position: At the case, on the customer side
steps.direction: Point at the one you want in the case and move the phone a little toward it as your hand reaches.

captions.script: This one, still warm. Pointed and it was mine.
Straight off the tray and into the bag.

steps.title: The break
steps.position: At the counter, phone at pastry height
steps.direction: Rest your elbows on the counter, phone level with the pastry, and tear it open toward the lens. Hold still.

captions.script: Listen to that crust. That's how you know it's fresh.
Look inside. Soft, airy, and still warm in the middle.
That crumb is the reason I came in this morning.

steps.title: What I took
steps.position: At the counter or outside, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level, the bag or pastry in frame. Say what you got and what it cost.
steps.prompter: This batch just came out, and here is what I'm taking home.

captions.script: This batch just came out, and here is what I'm taking home.
Get here when the batch comes out, they go fast.

templates.title: Morning shift
templates.summary: The baker's hour before the doors open: the dark shop, the dough, the oven, the full case and your first pick.

steps.title: Before opening
steps.position: Inside, by the door, before opening
steps.direction: Ask the baker first. Hold the phone still from the door while the baker works at the bench in the half-dark shop.

captions.script: Early start, and the baker is already at the bench.
This is what happens before the first customer walks in.

steps.title: The dough
steps.position: Beside the bench, phone above it
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the bench, elbows tucked, and keep it still while the hands shape or fold the dough.

captions.script: Here is how the dough gets shaped, right at the bench.
Shaping the loaves for the first bake of the day.

steps.title: Into the oven
steps.position: Facing the oven, a step back
steps.direction: Phone at chest height facing the oven. Move in slowly as the tray comes out until the bread fills the screen.

captions.script: First bake of the day, straight out of the oven.
Steam off the tray. This is the smell that hits you at the door.

steps.title: The case fills
steps.position: In front of the case
steps.direction: Start with the phone almost touching a loaf in the case, then lean back slowly so the full case comes into view.

captions.script: The case is full, and the doors are about to open.
Here is everything that came out of the back this morning.

steps.title: First pick
steps.position: At the counter, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level, the case behind you. Say what you would get first and the price.
steps.prompter: Doors just opened, and this is the one I would get first.

captions.script: Doors just opened, and this is the one I would get first.
Come at opening for the first bake. Here's the price.

templates.title: Before it sells out
templates.summary: Arrive early for the item that sells out: the line, the last tray, the inside and whether it was worth the alarm.

steps.title: The mission
steps.position: Across the sidewalk from the bakery
steps.direction: Back camera on the shopfront: hold the sign and the door steady, then flick the phone right toward the line. Record the line as a voice-over afterwards.

captions.script: I heard these sell out fast, so I came early today.
Here is when they usually run out. Let's see if I make it.

steps.title: The line
steps.position: Outside or at the back of the line
steps.direction: Film from behind the line so no faces show. Turn slowly along it, then flick the phone fast to the right.

captions.script: This is the line at opening, and I'm in it for one pastry.
Here is how long I waited. Let's see if it's worth it.

steps.title: The last tray
steps.position: At the case, looking down
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the case at an angle and move in slowly toward the tray of the item.

captions.script: Here is the tray, and I got one.
Here is how many are left. That's why you come early.

steps.title: Inside
steps.position: At the counter or outside, phone at pastry height
steps.direction: Hold the pastry level with the lens, elbows tucked, and tear or cut it open toward the camera. Hold still.

captions.script: This is what people line up for. Look at the inside.
Here is the filling. Look how far it goes.

steps.title: Worth it?
steps.position: Outside, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level with the pastry in frame. Give your verdict, the price and when to come.
steps.prompter: Worth the early alarm? Here's the price and when to get here.

captions.script: Worth the early alarm? Here's the price and when to get here.
Set an alarm and get here early. It goes fast.

templates.title: Build a box
templates.summary: A mixed box on a budget: the plan, the case, each pick, the open box and the total with a favourite.

steps.title: The budget
steps.position: Inside, in front of the case
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level, the case behind you. Say who the box is for and your budget.
steps.prompter: Building a box for the office with twenty dollars. Let's see what fits.

captions.script: Building a box for the office with twenty dollars. Let's see what fits.
One box, twenty dollars, as many favourites as I can fit.

steps.title: The case
steps.position: In front of the display case
steps.direction: Phone at shelf height, slide sideways along the case at an even pace so the labels and prices pass by.

captions.script: Here is everything in the case, with the prices as we pass.
Here are the prices, so you can see what fits.

steps.title: The picks
steps.position: At the case, customer side
steps.direction: Back camera from your eyes: point at each pastry as it goes into the box, moving in slowly toward the box.

captions.script: One of each, and here is what goes into the box.
Pointing, they pack. Watching the total as the box fills.

steps.title: The box
steps.position: At a table, phone above the box
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the open box, close, then lift it slowly so the whole box and the table show.

captions.script: Here it is: everything I could fit in one box.
Office breakfast, sorted. Nobody will ask who brought it.

steps.title: The total
steps.position: At the table, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level with the box in frame. Say the total and your favourite.
steps.prompter: Here's what twenty dollars got me, and the one I'd buy again.

captions.script: Here's what twenty dollars got me, and the one I'd buy again.
Under budget, and here is the clear winner of the box.

templates.title: Ask the baker
templates.summary: One question to the person who bakes it: their hands at work, the question, their pick, the inside and your verdict.

steps.title: At the bench
steps.position: Beside the bench, phone above it
steps.direction: Ask the baker first. Hold the phone straight above the bench and keep it still while they score, pipe or shape.

captions.script: This is the person who makes everything in the case.
Watch the hands. This is where the case gets filled.

steps.title: The question
steps.position: Across the counter from the baker
steps.direction: Back camera on the baker at chest height, hold still, your face in the small window. Ask your question, then let them answer.
steps.prompter: Quick question for the baker: what do you eat after your shift?

captions.script: Quick question for the baker: what do you eat after your shift?
I asked the baker what I should order, and here is the answer.

steps.title: Their pick
steps.position: At the case, customer side
steps.direction: Back camera from your eyes: follow the baker's hand to their pick and move in slowly as it comes out of the case.

captions.script: Here is their answer, and I've never ordered it.
The baker's own favourite, and here is why they picked it.

steps.title: Inside
steps.position: At the counter, phone at pastry height
steps.direction: Rest your elbows on the counter, phone level with the pastry, and tear or cut it open toward the lens. Hold still.

captions.script: Look at the inside. This is what the baker eats.
Look at the crumb. This is the baker's own choice.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: At the counter or a table, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level with the pastry in frame. Give your verdict and the price.
steps.prompter: The baker's pick, what it costs, and whether I'd order it again.

captions.script: The baker's pick, what it costs, and whether I'd order it again.
Next time, ask the baker. Here is how their pick compared to my usual.

oven.reads: The tray and its steam grow toward the lens; match-cut on the same tray sliding into the case.

shelf.reads: The case slides past at an even pace, front pastries faster than the back; cut to the creator's view.

pick.reads: The chosen pastry grows as the hand reaches toward it; cut to the pastry held at lens height.

break.reads: The pastry splits toward the lens and the inside opens, nothing else moves; cut to the creator's face.

outro.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, face and bag held still while the price lands.

lights.reads: The half-dark shop holds still while the baker moves at the bench; cut to the dough from above.

dough.reads: Hands fold and shape the dough, filling the frame from above; cut to the oven door at eye level.

oven.reads: The tray grows until the crust fills the frame; push through to a loaf being set in the case.

case.reads: The loaf shrinks back into a full case as the camera leans away; cut to the creator's face.

first.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, face and full case held still while the pick and price land.

hook.reads: The shopfront holds steady, sign above the door, while the line is voiced over; a whip right lands on the queue.

line.reads: The line slides past from behind; a whip to the right lands on the tray in the case.

tray.reads: The tray grows until one pastry fills the frame; match-cut on that pastry held up at eye level.

break.reads: The pastry splits toward the lens and the filling or layers show; cut to the creator's face.

verdict.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, face and pastry held still while the price and time land.

hook.reads: A face at arm's length from slightly above with the case behind, held still; cut to the case itself.

case.reads: The case slides past at an even pace, labels and prices readable; cut to the creator's view.

pick.reads: Each pick drops in and the box grows toward the lens; match-cut on the open box seen from above.

box.reads: The pastries from above shrink as the camera lifts and the whole box appears; cut to the creator's face.

total.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, face and box held still while the total lands.

hands.reads: Hands work the dough or the piping bag, filling the frame from above; cut to the baker at eye level.

ask.reads: The baker across the counter, held still while the question is asked and answered; cut to the creator's view of the case.

answer.reads: The baker's pick grows toward the lens as it is lifted out; match-cut on the same pastry held level with the camera.

inside.reads: The pastry opens toward the lens and the inside shows, nothing else moves; cut to the creator's face.

verdict.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, face and pastry held still while the verdict lands.
